Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip provide user-friendly interfaces but come with steep fees that cut into your profits. For instance, Gumroad takes a significant 10% from each sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. In contrast, using a sovereign stack like COREMERCH gives you complete control over your sales with no platform restrictions, allowing you to sell ebooks directly to your audience without ongoing fees. This results in greater profitability and flexibility in managing your digital products.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For digital creators in countries with financial restrictions, such as Venezuela or Zimbabwe, traditional platforms often fail to accommodate local payment methods. These creators are left searching for alternatives that work. By leveraging NOWPayments within the COREMERCH architecture, you can accept Bitcoin and over 300 other cryptocurrencies without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. This infrastructure is built to empower creators globally, ensuring everyone can monetize their digital products effectively.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed and fees are critical. NOWPayments ensures immediate payment verification on-chain, allowing creators to receive funds almost instantaneously. In contrast, platforms like Gumroad can hold funds for several days while charging high fees on each transaction. For example, if you sell 100 ebooks at $97 each through Gumroad, the 10% fee means you lose $970. In contrast, using NOWPayments would cost you only $48.50, allowing you to retain an additional $921 in revenue each month.
Gumroad's 10% fees can cripple your earnings — NOWPayments only takes 0.5%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the primary advantages of adopting a sovereign commerce stack is the ownership you gain over your entire sales architecture. With COREMERCH, after deployment, you own everything — the code, the payment processing, and the customer data. Automated delivery of ebooks via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensures your customers receive their purchases instantly, eliminating delays associated with third-party platforms. This level of automation combined with ownership means you can scale your business without worrying about restrictions or fees.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The best choice for you hinges on your specific needs. If you want a quick setup and are selling a smaller number of products, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a solid option. However, if you're looking for more scalability and advanced features, the Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go. For those who need comprehensive guidance, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation and integration guides to help you deploy the right stack for your business. Assess your product offerings and choose the architecture that aligns with your growth goals.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Own your infrastructure; don’t rent it from platforms that charge steep fees.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
